option_relations.rationale: An orbital abscess secondary to acute dacryocystitis is a broader category that can include a lacrimal sac abscess, which is a specific type of abscess in the orbital region.
Acute dacryocystitis with orbital cellulitis describes an infection of the lacrimal sac and surrounding orbital tissues, but does not specifically mention an abscess of the lacrimal sac.
Orbital cellulitis secondary to dacryocystitis describes an infection of the orbital tissues originating from the lacrimal sac, but does not specifically mention an abscess of the lacrimal sac.
Acute dacryocystitis with secondary optic nerve injury describes an infection of the lacrimal sac and a complication, but does not specifically mention an abscess of the lacrimal sac.
